name: Easy Additional Tags
author: dufour_l

sections.description:
Easy Additional Tags is an update to the much loved Multiple Tags plugin.
Through this plugin, users are able to use additional tags, which are combined under groups called “groups tag name”

Users are able :

  • to add tags, which are combined under groups called “groups tag name”
  • to add up to ten custom groups tag name
  • to select the groups tag name in Add New Post section
  • once they have published a post, all tags under the respective group name will be added to the tag section.
  • to edit the additional tags in quick edit
  • to bulk edit

For More information : https://laurentdufour.eu
sections.installation:
1. Upload the “easy-additional-tags” directory to the plugins directory.
  2. Go to the plugins setting page and activate “Easy Additional Tags”.
  3. Go to Settings –> Easy Additional Tags –> Fill the group name and tags [ Tags should be comma separated ]. Find the sample input in setting page.
  4. Users are able to view Easy Additional Tags in Posting area.

For More information : https://laurentdufour.eu

  • Migrated to Advanced Mutiple Tags

3.2

  • Each Group Tag Name, now becomes a keyword, that you can reuse as a tag in another Group of Tags
    Eg : Create a group tag called ‘Fruit’, with ‘Orange, Apple, Pear’
    You can now use in another group of tag the following keyword %Fruit%

        Eg : New groupe tag 'Ice-Cream' ==> 'Milk, Ice Cream, %Fruit%'
        It will be expanded as 'Milk, Ice Cream, Orange, Apple, Pear'
    • You can use as many keywords from a group name as you want, as far as this group name exists.
